title: test(vue-query): align mock names with react-query and the options they are passed to
body:
## 🎯 Changes

Renames `vi.fn`/`vi.spyOn` mocks in `vue-query`'s runtime tests so they follow the names used in `react-query`'s tests, or the option they are passed to when `react-query` has no equivalent:

| Before | After | Files |
|---|---|---|
| `fetchFn`, `fnSpy` (passed as `queryFn`) | `queryFn` | `useQuery`, `useQueries`, `useInfiniteQuery`, `vueQueryPlugin` |
| `fnMock` (passed as `mutationFn`) | `mutationFn` | `useMutation`, `mutationOptions` |
| `boundaryFn`, `throwOnErrorFn` (passed as `throwOnError`) | `throwOnError` | `useQuery`, `useMutation` |
| `warnSpy` (`console.warn` spy) | `consoleMock` | `useQuery`, `useQueries`, `useMutation`, `useIsFetching`, `usePrefetchQuery`, `usePrefetchInfiniteQuery` |
| `onSuccessPerCall`, `onSettledOnFunction` (callbacks passed to `mutate()`) | `onSuccessMutate`, `onSettledMutate` | `useMutation` |

Where the new name matches the option key, the property uses shorthand (`queryFn: fetchFn,` → `queryFn,`).

Renames only; no test behavior changes.
